en: A monochrome winter scene showing a large multi‑storey building complex labeled "Hammermühle Neunzehnhain" surrounded by snow‑covered trees and half‑timbered houses. The landscape includes a frozen or snow-lined waterway in the foreground and dense forest in the background, evoking a mountainous or hilly rural area. The overall style and printing resemble an early‑20th‑century photographic postcard.
